title: Hasbunallāhu wa niʿmal Wakīl
translation: Allah is enough for us and He is the Best Protector.

title: Ḥasbiya-Allāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa
arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa Rabbul-ʿArshil-ʿAẓīm
translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god worthy of worship except Him. I have placed my trust in Him only and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
reference: Abū al-Dardā' (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrates... (Ibn al-Sunnī 71)

title: Rabbi innī limā anzalta illayya min khayrin faqīr
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّيْ لِمَآ أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيْرٌ
transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr
translation: My Lord, truly I am in dire need of any good which You may send me.

title: Duʿāʾ for Love and Strength
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْـنِيْ حُبَّكَ ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يَّنْفَعُنِيْ حُبُّهُ عِنْدَكَ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِيْ مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِّيْ فِيْمَا تُحِبُّ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّيْ مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغًا لِّيْ فِيْمَا تُحِبُّ
transliteration: Allāhummar-zuqnī ḥubbak, wa ḥubba man yanfaʿunī ḥubbuhu ʿindak, Allāhumma mā razaqtanī mimmā uḥibbu faj-ʿalhu quwwatan lī fīmā tuḥibb, Allāhumma mā zawayta ʿannī mimmā uḥibbu faj-ʿalhu farāghan lī fīmā tuḥibb
translation: O Allah, grant me Your love and the love of those whose love will benefit me with You. O Allah, whatever You have provided me of the things that I love, make them a source of strength for me in pursuing what You love. O Allah, whatever you have withheld from me from what I love, make its absence a means for me to pursue what You love.
reference: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd Al-Khatmī Al-Ansarī (raḍiy Allāhu 'anhu) narrated... (Tirmidhī 3491)

title: Duʿāʾ for Well-being and Protection
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِيْ وَمَالِيْ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِيْ وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِيْ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ احْفَظْنِيْ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِيْ ، وَعَنْ يَّمِيْنِيْ ، وَعَنْ شِمَالِيْ ، وَمِنْ فَوْقِيْ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِيْ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-ʿāfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah, Allāhumma innī as'alukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī wa mālī, Allāhummastūr ʿawrātī wa āmin rawʿātī, Allāhummaḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfī, wa ʿan yamīnī, wa ʿan shimālī, wa min fawqī, wa aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī
translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from in front of me and behind me, from my right, and from my left, and from above me. I seek protection in Your Greatness from being unexpectedly destroyed from beneath me.
reference: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhumā) narrated: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never failed to say these words in the morning and in the evening.' (Abū Dāwūd 5074)
